_comment: Design tokens that are defined but deliberately read by no rule. Each needs a reason, so silencing a token that should have shipped requires an argument in a diff.
--hover-opacity: The export defines .7 for an opacity-based hover the design system then rules out: hover is 'links shift to --link-hover and gain an underline', and press is 'no transform, no scale, no colour change'. Nothing should fade on hover, so nothing reads it.
